attrs.evidence: Written down so the three-way distinction is visible as three objects rather than two objects and an implication. The rule as declared: promotion is blocked while assurance_state is contested or undermined; residual_risk requires a named authority and a review date; truth status is never altered. FAC-RECEIPT-DECISIVE is where this would become an output rather than a paragraph, and it is open. Recording a policy nothing enforces is exactly the C10 shape this artifact has committed four times, so it is typed DECLARED and says so in its own registry entry.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6's adjudication §6: truth status, assurance state and promotion admissibility are three objects. Bloomfield, Netkachova & Rushby, Assurance 2.0 (SRI-CSL-2024-01) for the confidence/decision separation.
attrs.statement: Promotion admissibility is a third object, consuming truth status and assurance state and neither of them alone. It is DECLARED and no gate reads it.
